hearts.tri: Enter shop 9 AM–12 PM any weekday
hearts.story: Abigail feels overshadowed by Caroline in the family shop. She vents about wanting freedom and adventure.

hearts.tri: Enter her room when she's home (mornings)
hearts.story: She's deep in a video game and invites you to play. A relaxed, fun bonding moment that shows her true personality.

hearts.tri: Enter The Mines on a non-rainy day (8 AM–5 PM)
hearts.story: You find Abigail alone in the mines — not scared, but sword-fighting for practice. You team up to fight monsters together.

hearts.tri: Visit the lake at 8 PM–12 AM on a clear night
hearts.story: A quiet, romantic moment by the water under the stars. Feelings begin to surface between you both.

hearts.tri: Enter her room when she's home (any time)
hearts.story: She plays her ocarina for you by moonlight. An intimate and memorable scene that cements your bond.

sched.l: In front of his house or exercising

hearts.tri: Enter 1 Willow Lane between 9 AM–7 PM
hearts.story: Alex plays with his dog Dusty and opens up about his difficult childhood and his absent father.

hearts.tri: Enter his room upstairs
hearts.story: He's looking at old family photos. You see a vulnerable side behind the confident jock exterior.

hearts.tri: Enter Saloon on Friday or Saturday evening
hearts.story: Alex shares his dreams of going pro. You can encourage or challenge him — he takes it seriously either way.

hearts.tri: Triggered on a specific Saturday after prior events
hearts.story: Alex visits his late mother's grave at the hospital. A deeply emotional scene about loss and healing.

hearts.tri: Enter his house any time
hearts.story: He confides his real goals and how knowing you has helped him grow. He says he's ready for a real future.

hearts.tri: Enter cabin between 9 AM–4 PM
hearts.story: Elliott reads you a poem he wrote. He's clearly talented but uncertain about his path as a writer.

hearts.tri: Enter library Tue/Thu afternoons when he's there
hearts.story: He shares his literary influences and dreams of writing a truly great novel someday.

hearts.tri: Enter Saloon Friday/Saturday evening
hearts.story: Elliott plays piano beautifully. His music and presence captivate the room — and you.

hearts.tri: Enter cabin after he announces his novel is complete
hearts.story: He finishes his novel and celebrates with champagne. He's overjoyed and shows you the dedication page.

hearts.tri: Visit the beach on a clear day (his schedule day)
hearts.story: Elliott recites the novel's dedication on the shoreline — it's about you. A grand romantic gesture.

hearts.tri: Enter 2 Willow Lane when she's home (morning/Saturday)
hearts.story: Emily chats with her parrot about crystal energy and dreams. She's quirky, spiritual, and genuine.

hearts.tri: Enter house in the evening when she's home
hearts.story: She shows you her clothing-making hobby and sews magical outfits with her own creative flair.

hearts.tri: Enter the Desert any time after unlocking the bus
hearts.story: A mystical dream sequence — Emily appears as a dancer in a surreal vision. Personal and enchanting.

hearts.tri: Enter house on a specific night
hearts.story: Emily performs a crystal-inspired dance just for you. Magical and wonderfully intimate.

hearts.tri: Visit mountain at night on a clear evening
hearts.story: She invites you stargazing. She talks about the universe, meaning, and where you fit in her world.

sched.l: Airstrip north of farm watching planes

hearts.story: Harvey talks about his passion for preventive care and concern for the health of the whole village.

hearts.tri: Enter his room above the clinic
hearts.story: You see miniature planes on his desk. He sheepishly confesses his secret dream: to learn to fly.

hearts.tri: Enter Saloon on Tuesday evening
hearts.story: Harvey and Maru discuss a difficult patient case. You glimpse his professional dedication.

hearts.tri: Visit airstrip area at 6 AM–9 AM on weekends
hearts.story: Harvey takes you on a hot air balloon ride despite being terrified of heights. Endearing and hilarious.

hearts.tri: Enter clinic on a specific day
hearts.story: Harvey gives you a check-up, flustered the whole time, and finally confesses his feelings for you.

hearts.tri: Walk through town when Haley is there (11 AM–4 PM)
hearts.story: Haley asks you to carry her groceries — very entitled about it. But she surprises you with a quick thanks.

hearts.tri: Enter her room when she's home (afternoons)
hearts.story: She's looking at old family photos and softens considerably. A glimpse of her vulnerable, nostalgic side.

hearts.tri: Walk the south path on a sunny day (her schedule day)
hearts.story: Haley drops her bracelet into a dry well. You help retrieve it — she's genuinely and unexpectedly grateful.

hearts.tri: Visit the beach on a sunny morning (9 AM–4 PM)
hearts.story: Haley takes your portrait at the beach. Her photography is surprisingly thoughtful and artistic.

hearts.tri: Enter her house any afternoon
hearts.story: She's set up a professional darkroom. Her photos are beautiful. She thanks you for believing in her creative side.

hearts.tri: Enter her cottage any afternoon
hearts.story: She shows you a wood carving she's working on. Passionate but uncertain if her art has real value.

hearts.tri: Enter cottage in the morning
hearts.story: Leah stares at a blank canvas, frustrated. She's struggling with creative block and self-doubt.

hearts.tri: Enter Saloon on Friday evening
hearts.story: Her ex, Kel, shows up unexpectedly. A tense confrontation about whether she's throwing her life away on art.

hearts.tri: Visit on her art show event day (specific date)
hearts.story: Leah holds a sculpture exhibition. The whole town attends — a triumphant, joyful moment for her.

hearts.tri: Enter her cottage any time
hearts.story: She asks if you'd spend your life with her. She envisions a quiet, creative life together in the valley.

hearts.tri: Visit mountain at night (9 PM–12 AM) on a clear day

hearts.tri: Visit at night on a clear evening
hearts.story: Maru has prepared a special light show using her inventions. She projects her feelings across the night sky.

hearts.tri: Enter the spa on her schedule day
hearts.story: A peaceful spa day together. Penny opens up about dreaming of a stable, warm home environment.

hearts.tri: Varies by day and time
hearts.story: Penny talks about the home she's always imagined. She wonders if you two could build that life together.

hearts.tri: Enter his basement room on a specific day
